dedupe_keys.name: iea 3 4 mw reference wind turbine hawc2 input output files

description: Göçmen, Tuhfe and colleagues describe this resource in the native deposit. The deposit contains HAWC2 input and output files for the IEA 3.4 MW reference turbine. Its archive is split into parts because of repository size limits; the parts belong to one resource. The native description points to a README for further details, but that body was not opened. Exact simulation cases, channels, time steps and relation to other TWAIN training datasets remain unestablished. Reference-turbine results are not described as observations from a commercial turbine. Zenodo provides the deposit with open access under cc-by-4.0. The native file inventory establishes deposited data, but values and linked file bodies were not read. Coverage is limited to the stated experiment, model or application; transfer to other turbines, sites or operating regimes requires separate assessment. Publication date alone does not establish current maintenance.
